"""逐次改坏31381 SPJ，运行独立回归，最后恢复源码。"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

path = Path('data/openjudge/tests/30000-/31381_made/checker.py')
original = path.read_text()
cases = [
    ('只比较集合而非字符重数', 'Counter(given) == Counter(actual)', 'set(given) == set(actual)'),
    ('错误忽略输入首尾空格', 'Counter(given)', 'Counter(given.strip())'),
    ('错误忽略输出首尾空格', 'Counter(actual)', 'Counter(actual.strip())'),
    ('错误容忍额外空行', "text = text[:-1]", "text = text.rstrip('\\n')"),
    ('错误替换学生非法UTF8', "raw.decode('utf-8')", "raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')"),
    ('遗漏输出长度保护', 'if len(raw) > MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES:', 'if False:'),
    ('把非法输入误判学生WA', "print('判题输入格式有误')\n        return 3", "print('判题输入格式有误')\n        return 42"),
    ('错误按参考答案而非输入判断', 'if not matches(given, actual):', "if not matches(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_text(), actual):"),
    ('遗漏多行拒绝', "if '\\n' in text or '\\r' in text:", 'if False:'),
]
results = []
try:
    for name, before, after in cases:
        assert original.count(before) == 1, name
        path.write_text(original.replace(before, after))
        result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'tests.test_31381_checker'], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), timeout=30)
        assert result.returncode != 0, name
        results.append({'mutation': name, 'detected': True, 'exit_code': result.returncode})
        path.write_text(original)
finally:
    path.write_text(original)
test_path = Path('tests/test_31381_checker.py')
test_original = test_path.read_text()
try:
    broken = test_original.replace(", patch.object(judge, 'LIMITS_CACHE', {})", '')
    assert broken != test_original
    test_path.write_text(broken)
    result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'tests.test_31381_checker'], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'), timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode != 0
    results.append({'mutation': '遗漏临时题库限时缓存隔离', 'detected': True, 'exit_code': result.returncode})
finally:
    test_path.write_text(test_original)
source = Path(__file__).read_text()
Path('collab/gmyhf-31381-spj-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results': results, 'checker_sha256': hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest(), 'procedure_source': source, 'procedure_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(results), '种实际变异检出，源码恢复')
